topics.title: Nomenclature and structure of the carbonyl group

concepts.learning_objective: Write common and IUPAC names of aldehydes and ketones, including ring and unsaturated compounds.
Describe the hybridisation, geometry and polarity of the carbonyl group.
Choose reagents and named reactions that give aldehydes from alcohols, hydrocarbons, acyl chlorides, nitriles and esters.
Choose methods that give ketones from acyl chlorides, nitriles, alkynes and arenes.

topics.title: Physical properties and uses of aldehydes and ketones

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the boiling points and solubility of aldehydes and ketones in terms of intermolecular forces.
State important uses of common aldehydes and ketones.

topics.title: Nucleophilic addition, reduction and oxidation of aldehydes and ketones

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the mechanism of nucleophilic addition and the relative reactivity of aldehydes and ketones.
Identify reagents that reduce carbonyl compounds to alcohols or to hydrocarbons.
Use oxidation reactions such as Tollens', Fehling's and iodoform tests to distinguish and identify carbonyl compounds.

topics.title: Reactions due to alpha-hydrogen and other reactions

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why the alpha-hydrogens of aldehydes and ketones are acidic.
Predict the products of aldol and cross aldol condensation.
Identify aldehydes that undergo the Cannizzaro reaction and predict its products.

topics.title: Carboxylic acids: nomenclature, preparation and physical properties

concepts.learning_objective: Write common and IUPAC names of mono- and dicarboxylic acids.
Choose methods to prepare carboxylic acids from alcohols, alkylbenzenes, nitriles and Grignard reagents.
Explain the boiling points and solubility of carboxylic acids.
Compare the acidity of carboxylic acids with phenols and alcohols using conjugate base stability.
Predict how electron withdrawing and donating groups change the acidity of carboxylic acids.

topics.title: Other reactions and uses of carboxylic acids

concepts.learning_objective: Write reactions that replace the -OH of the carboxyl group to give acid chlorides, esters, anhydrides and amides.
Describe reduction and decarboxylation of carboxylic acids and the reagents used.
Explain the Hell-Volhard-Zelinsky reaction and ring substitution in aromatic acids.
